description: PostgreSQL repository health, capacity, partition growth, source-database estimates, collector freshness, and query workload for Harry.

panels.description: Current physical size of the PostgreSQL database containing Harry, including indexes and TOAST.

targets.rawSql: select pg_database_size(current_database())::double precision as value;

panels.title: Repository Size

panels.description: Planner row estimates from Harry partition leaves and non-partitioned repository tables. No retained sample table is scanned.

targets.rawSql:
with roots as (
  select c.oid
  from pg_class c
  join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace
  where n.nspname = current_schema()
    and c.relkind = 'p'
    and (c.relname like 'oracle\_%' escape '\' or c.relname = 'harry_repository_daily_ingest')
), leaf_rows as (
  select greatest(c.reltuples, 0)::numeric as rows
  from roots r
  cross join lateral pg_partition_tree(r.oid) t
  join pg_class c on c.oid = t.relid
  where t.isleaf
), regular_rows as (
  select greatest(c.reltuples, 0)::numeric as rows
  from pg_class c
  join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace
  where n.nspname = current_schema()
    and c.relkind in ('r', 'm')
    and (c.relname like 'oracle\_%' escape '\' or c.relname = 'harry_repository_daily_ingest')
    and not exists (select 1 from pg_inherits i where i.inhrelid = c.oid)
)
select coalesce(sum(rows), 0)::double precision as value
from (select rows from leaf_rows union all select rows from regular_rows) all_rows;

panels.title: Estimated Harry Rows

panels.description: Number of physical daily partition leaves currently retained by Harry tables.

targets.rawSql:
select count(*)::double precision as value
from pg_class root
join pg_namespace n on n.oid = root.relnamespace
cross join lateral pg_partition_tree(root.oid) t
where n.nspname = current_schema()
  and root.relkind = 'p'
  and (root.relname like 'oracle\_%' escape '\' or root.relname = 'harry_repository_daily_ingest')
  and t.isleaf;

panels.title: Retained Partitions

panels.description: Age of the oldest dated Harry partition. This reflects physical retention, not only the configured value.

targets.rawSql:
with days as (
  select to_date(substring(child.relname from '([0-9]{4}_[0-9]{2}_[0-9]{2})$'), 'YYYY_MM_DD') as day
  from pg_class root
  join pg_namespace n on n.oid = root.relnamespace
  cross join lateral pg_partition_tree(root.oid) t
  join pg_class child on child.oid = t.relid
  where n.nspname = current_schema()
    and root.relkind = 'p'
    and (root.relname like 'oracle\_%' escape '\' or root.relname = 'harry_repository_daily_ingest')
    and t.isleaf
)
select coalesce(current_date - min(day), 0)::double precision as value
from days
where day is not null;

panels.title: Oldest Retained Data

panels.description: Current PostgreSQL backends connected to the Harry repository database.

targets.rawSql: select numbackends::double precision as value from pg_stat_database where datname = current_database();

panels.title: Repository Connections

panels.description: PostgreSQL shared-buffer hit ratio since database statistics were reset.

targets.rawSql: select case when blks_hit + blks_read = 0 then 100 else blks_hit * 100.0 / (blks_hit + blks_read) end::double precision as value from pg_stat_database where datname = current_database();

panels.title: Buffer Cache Hit

panels.description: Current physical table, index, and total allocation grouped by Harry root dataset. Values include every retained partition.

targets.rawSql:
with roots as (
  select c.oid, c.relname
  from pg_class c
  join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace
  where n.nspname = current_schema()
    and c.relkind = 'p'
    and (c.relname like 'oracle\_%' escape '\' or c.relname = 'harry_repository_daily_ingest')
), partitioned as (
  select r.relname as dataset,
         sum(pg_table_size(t.relid))::bigint as table_bytes,
         sum(pg_indexes_size(t.relid))::bigint as index_bytes,
         sum(pg_total_relation_size(t.relid))::bigint as total_bytes,
         sum(greatest(c.reltuples, 0))::bigint as estimated_rows,
         count(*)::bigint as partitions
  from roots r
  cross join lateral pg_partition_tree(r.oid) t
  join pg_class c on c.oid = t.relid
  where t.isleaf
  group by r.relname
), regular as (
  select c.relname as dataset, pg_table_size(c.oid)::bigint as table_bytes,
         pg_indexes_size(c.oid)::bigint as index_bytes,
         pg_total_relation_size(c.oid)::bigint as total_bytes,
         greatest(c.reltuples, 0)::bigint as estimated_rows, 0::bigint as partitions
  from pg_class c
  join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace
  where n.nspname = current_schema()
    and c.relkind in ('r', 'm')
    and (c.relname like 'oracle\_%' escape '\' or c.relname = 'harry_repository_daily_ingest')
    and not exists (select 1 from pg_inherits i where i.inhrelid = c.oid)
)
select * from partitioned
union all
select * from regular
order by total_bytes desc;

panels.title: Harry Dataset Storage

panels.description: Current physical size of each dated partition plotted by its partition day. This is a present-time partition inventory, not historical size sampling.

targets.rawSql:
select
  to_date(substring(child.relname from '([0-9]{4}_[0-9]{2}_[0-9]{2})$'), 'YYYY_MM_DD')::timestamptz as time,
  root.relname as metric,
  pg_total_relation_size(child.oid)::double precision as value
from pg_class root
join pg_namespace n on n.oid = root.relnamespace
cross join lateral pg_partition_tree(root.oid) t
join pg_class child on child.oid = t.relid
where n.nspname = current_schema()
  and root.relkind = 'p'
  and (root.relname like 'oracle\_%' escape '\' or root.relname = 'harry_repository_daily_ingest')
  and t.isleaf
  and substring(child.relname from '([0-9]{4}_[0-9]{2}_[0-9]{2})$') is not null
order by time, metric;

panels.title: Daily Partition Storage by Dataset

panels.description: Estimated physical allocation by source database. Harry's recorded rows provide the exact per-dataset share; PostgreSQL partition sizes provide physical bytes. Shared heap and index pages mean attribution remains an estimate.

targets.rawSql:
with leaf_sizes as (
  select root.relname as dataset,
         to_date(substring(child.relname from '([0-9]{4}_[0-9]{2}_[0-9]{2})$'), 'YYYY_MM_DD') as sample_day,
         pg_total_relation_size(child.oid)::numeric as bytes
  from pg_class root
  join pg_namespace n on n.oid = root.relnamespace
  cross join lateral pg_partition_tree(root.oid) t
  join pg_class child on child.oid = t.relid
  where n.nspname = current_schema() and root.relkind = 'p'
    and root.relname like 'oracle\_%' escape '\' and t.isleaf
), accounting as (
  select i.sample_day::date as sample_day, i.source_database, values.dataset, values.rows::numeric as rows
  from harry_repository_daily_ingest i
  cross join lateral (values
    ('oracle_metric_samples', i.additional_metric_rows),
    ('oracle_sql_samples', i.sql_sample_rows),
    ('oracle_session_samples', i.session_sample_rows),
    ('oracle_blocking_session_samples', i.blocking_session_sample_rows),
    ('oracle_database_activity_samples', i.database_activity_sample_rows),
    ('oracle_database_status_samples', i.database_status_sample_rows),
    ('oracle_instance_samples', i.instance_sample_rows),
    ('oracle_resource_limit_samples', i.resource_limit_sample_rows),
    ('oracle_tablespace_samples', i.tablespace_sample_rows),
    ('oracle_asm_diskgroup_samples', i.asm_diskgroup_sample_rows),
    ('oracle_system_counter_samples', i.system_counter_sample_rows),
    ('oracle_wait_class_samples', i.wait_class_sample_rows),
    ('oracle_system_metric_samples', i.system_metric_sample_rows),
    ('oracle_scrape_status', i.scrape_status_rows)
  ) values(dataset, rows)
  where i.sample_day between
    (date_trunc('day', ($__timeFrom()) at time zone 'UTC') at time zone 'UTC')
    and (date_trunc('day', ($__timeTo()) at time zone 'UTC') at time zone 'UTC')
), totals as (
  select sample_day, dataset, sum(rows) as rows
  from accounting
  group by sample_day, dataset
)
select a.source_database as metric,
       sum(l.bytes * a.rows / nullif(t.rows, 0))::double precision as value
from accounting a
join totals t using (sample_day, dataset)
join leaf_sizes l using (sample_day, dataset)
where a.rows > 0
  and a.source_database in (${source_database:sqlstring})
group by a.source_database
order by value desc;

panels.title: Estimated Storage by Source Database

panels.description: Rows successfully handed to PostgreSQL by Harry during the selected range, grouped by source database. SQL text and plan counters represent successful write operations against their deduplicated dictionaries.

targets.rawSql:
select source_database as metric,
       sum(additional_metric_rows + sql_sample_rows + sql_text_writes + sql_plan_operation_writes +
           session_sample_rows + blocking_session_sample_rows + database_activity_sample_rows +
           database_status_sample_rows + instance_sample_rows + resource_limit_sample_rows +
           tablespace_sample_rows + asm_diskgroup_sample_rows + system_counter_sample_rows +
           wait_class_sample_rows + system_metric_sample_rows + scrape_status_rows)::double precision as value
from harry_repository_daily_ingest
where sample_day between
    (date_trunc('day', ($__timeFrom()) at time zone 'UTC') at time zone 'UTC')
    and (date_trunc('day', ($__timeTo()) at time zone 'UTC') at time zone 'UTC')
  and source_database in (${source_database:sqlstring})
group by source_database
order by value desc;

panels.title: Recorded Rows by Source Database

panels.description: Daily rows successfully handed to PostgreSQL by Harry for each selected source database. Values come from native ingestion accounting and do not depend on planner statistics.

targets.rawSql:
select greatest(sample_day, $__timeFrom()) as time, source_database as metric,
       (additional_metric_rows + sql_sample_rows + sql_text_writes + sql_plan_operation_writes +
        session_sample_rows + blocking_session_sample_rows + database_activity_sample_rows +
        database_status_sample_rows + instance_sample_rows + resource_limit_sample_rows +
        tablespace_sample_rows + asm_diskgroup_sample_rows + system_counter_sample_rows +
        wait_class_sample_rows + system_metric_sample_rows + scrape_status_rows)::double precision as value
from harry_repository_daily_ingest
where sample_day between
    (date_trunc('day', ($__timeFrom()) at time zone 'UTC') at time zone 'UTC')
    and (date_trunc('day', ($__timeTo()) at time zone 'UTC') at time zone 'UTC')
  and source_database in (${source_database:sqlstring})
order by time, metric;

panels.title: Daily Recorded Rows by Source Database

panels.description: PostgreSQL table statistics grouped by Harry root dataset. High dead-row percentages and stale ANALYZE timestamps require maintenance review.

targets.rawSql:
with stats as (
  select coalesce(parent.relname, child.relname) as dataset, s.*
  from pg_stat_user_tables s
  join pg_class child on child.oid = s.relid
  left join pg_inherits i on i.inhrelid = child.oid
  left join pg_class parent on parent.oid = i.inhparent
  where child.relname like 'oracle\_%' escape '\'
     or child.relname like 'harry_repository_daily_ingest%'
)
select dataset, sum(n_live_tup)::bigint as live_rows, sum(n_dead_tup)::bigint as dead_rows,
       case when sum(n_live_tup + n_dead_tup) = 0 then 0
            else sum(n_dead_tup) * 100.0 / sum(n_live_tup + n_dead_tup) end as dead_pct,
       sum(seq_scan)::bigint as seq_scans, sum(idx_scan)::bigint as index_scans,
       sum(n_tup_ins)::bigint as inserted, sum(n_tup_upd)::bigint as updated, sum(n_tup_del)::bigint as deleted,
       max(last_autovacuum) as last_autovacuum, max(last_autoanalyze) as last_autoanalyze,
       sum(pg_total_relation_size(relid))::bigint as total_bytes
from stats
group by dataset
order by dead_rows desc, total_bytes desc;

panels.title: Harry Table Health and Maintenance

panels.description: Cumulative PostgreSQL workload counters since the database statistics reset. These are not historical rates because Grafana does not persist catalog samples.

targets.rawSql:
select stats_reset, xact_commit as commits, xact_rollback as rollbacks,
       tup_returned, tup_fetched, tup_inserted, tup_updated, tup_deleted,
       temp_files, temp_bytes, deadlocks, conflicts,
       case when blks_hit + blks_read = 0 then 100 else blks_hit * 100.0 / (blks_hit + blks_read) end as cache_hit_pct
from pg_stat_database
where datname = current_database();

panels.title: Database Workload Since Stats Reset

panels.description: Daily rows written by Harry, grouped by native repository dataset. This exposes which collectors and datasets are responsible for repository growth.

targets.rawSql:
select greatest(i.sample_day, $__timeFrom()) as time, values.dataset as metric, sum(values.rows)::double precision as value
from harry_repository_daily_ingest i
cross join lateral (values
  ('Additional metrics', i.additional_metric_rows),
  ('SQL samples', i.sql_sample_rows),
  ('SQL text writes', i.sql_text_writes),
  ('SQL plan operations', i.sql_plan_operation_writes),
  ('Session samples', i.session_sample_rows),
  ('Blocking sessions', i.blocking_session_sample_rows),
  ('Database activity', i.database_activity_sample_rows),
  ('Database status', i.database_status_sample_rows),
  ('Instance samples', i.instance_sample_rows),
  ('Resource limits', i.resource_limit_sample_rows),
  ('Tablespaces', i.tablespace_sample_rows),
  ('ASM diskgroups', i.asm_diskgroup_sample_rows),
  ('System counters', i.system_counter_sample_rows),
  ('Wait classes', i.wait_class_sample_rows),
  ('System metrics', i.system_metric_sample_rows),
  ('Scrape status', i.scrape_status_rows)
) values(dataset, rows)
where i.sample_day between
    (date_trunc('day', ($__timeFrom()) at time zone 'UTC') at time zone 'UTC')
    and (date_trunc('day', ($__timeTo()) at time zone 'UTC') at time zone 'UTC')
  and i.source_database in (${source_database:sqlstring})
group by i.sample_day, values.dataset
having sum(values.rows) > 0
order by time, metric;

panels.title: Daily Recorded Rows by Dataset

panels.description: Latest accounting flush and dataset-specific sample timestamps. Accounting flushes every five minutes; stale values indicate PostgreSQL writes, scraper lifecycle, or collector output should be investigated.

targets.rawSql:
select source_database, max(last_flushed_at) as last_accounting_flush,
       extract(epoch from now() - max(last_flushed_at))::double precision as flush_age_seconds,
       max(last_sample_at) as last_repository_sample,
       max(last_sql_sample_at) as last_sql_sample,
       max(last_session_sample_at) as last_session_sample,
       max(last_database_activity_sample_at) as last_activity_sample,
       sum(case when sample_day::date = (now() at time zone 'UTC')::date then
         additional_metric_rows + sql_sample_rows + sql_text_writes + sql_plan_operation_writes +
         session_sample_rows + blocking_session_sample_rows + database_activity_sample_rows +
         database_status_sample_rows + instance_sample_rows + resource_limit_sample_rows +
         tablespace_sample_rows + asm_diskgroup_sample_rows + system_counter_sample_rows +
         wait_class_sample_rows + system_metric_sample_rows + scrape_status_rows else 0 end)::bigint as today_rows
from harry_repository_daily_ingest
where source_database in (${source_database:sqlstring})
group by source_database
order by flush_age_seconds desc;

panels.title: Repository Ingestion Continuity

panels.description: Currently executing or transaction-active PostgreSQL statements lasting at least one second. This includes scraper writes, Grafana reads, maintenance, and ad-hoc sessions.

targets.rawSql:
select pid, usename, application_name, client_addr, state, wait_event_type, wait_event,
       extract(epoch from now() - query_start)::double precision as query_seconds,
       extract(epoch from now() - xact_start)::double precision as transaction_seconds,
       left(query, 1000) as query
from pg_stat_activity
where datname = current_database()
  and pid <> pg_backend_pid()
  and state <> 'idle'
  and query_start < now() - interval '1 second'
order by query_start;

panels.title: Current Long-Running Repository Queries

panels.description: Current PostgreSQL sessions whose application_name identifies Grafana. Historical attribution requires a dedicated Grafana database role because pg_stat_statements does not retain application_name.

targets.rawSql:
select pid, usename, application_name, client_addr, state, wait_event_type, wait_event,
       extract(epoch from now() - backend_start)::double precision as backend_seconds,
       case when query_start is null then null else extract(epoch from now() - query_start)::double precision end as query_seconds,
       left(query, 1000) as query
from pg_stat_activity
where datname = current_database()
  and pid <> pg_backend_pid()
  and application_name ilike '%grafana%'
order by state, query_start nulls last;

panels.title: Current Grafana Repository Sessions

panels.description: 1 when pg_stat_statements exists and is loaded through shared_preload_libraries; otherwise historical repository query analysis is unavailable.

targets.rawSql:
select case
  when to_regclass('pg_stat_statements') is not null
   and 'pg_stat_statements' = any(string_to_array(replace(current_setting('shared_preload_libraries'), ' ', ''), ','))
  then 1 else 0 end::double precision as value;

panels.title: Query History

panels.description: Historical SELECT/WITH statements referencing Harry oracle_* relations, ranked by total execution time. Uses pg_stat_statements when available and returns no rows safely when disabled.

targets.rawSql:
with capability as (
  select to_regclass('pg_stat_statements') is not null
     and 'pg_stat_statements' = any(string_to_array(replace(current_setting('shared_preload_libraries'), ' ', ''), ',')) as enabled
), payload as (
  select case when enabled then query_to_xml($sql$
    select queryid, calls, total_exec_time / 1000.0 as total_exec_seconds,
           mean_exec_time as mean_exec_ms, max_exec_time as max_exec_ms, rows,
           shared_blks_hit, shared_blks_read, temp_blks_written, left(query, 2000) as query
    from pg_stat_statements
    where dbid = (select oid from pg_database where datname = current_database())
      and ltrim(query) ~* '^(select|with)'
      and query ~* 'oracle_[a-z0-9_]+'
      and query not ilike '%pg_stat_statements%'
    order by total_exec_time desc
    limit 30
  $sql$, true, false, '') else '<table/>'::xml end as doc
  from capability
)
select x.queryid, x.calls, x.total_exec_seconds, x.mean_exec_ms, x.max_exec_ms, x.rows,
       x.shared_blks_hit, x.shared_blks_read, x.temp_blks_written, x.query
from payload
cross join lateral xmltable('/table/row' passing payload.doc columns
  queryid bigint path 'queryid', calls bigint path 'calls',
  total_exec_seconds double precision path 'total_exec_seconds',
  mean_exec_ms double precision path 'mean_exec_ms', max_exec_ms double precision path 'max_exec_ms',
  rows bigint path 'rows', shared_blks_hit bigint path 'shared_blks_hit',
  shared_blks_read bigint path 'shared_blks_read', temp_blks_written bigint path 'temp_blks_written',
  query text path 'query') x
order by total_exec_seconds desc;

panels.title: Top Harry Repository Reads

panels.description: Current ungranted locks and their owning PostgreSQL sessions.

targets.rawSql:
select a.pid, a.usename, a.application_name, l.locktype, l.mode,
       coalesce(c.relname, l.relation::text) as relation,
       extract(epoch from now() - a.query_start)::double precision as waiting_seconds,
       pg_blocking_pids(a.pid) as blocking_pids, left(a.query, 1000) as query
from pg_locks l
join pg_stat_activity a on a.pid = l.pid
left join pg_class c on c.oid = l.relation
where not l.granted and a.datname = current_database()
order by a.query_start;

panels.title: Current PostgreSQL Lock Waits

panels.description: Current repository connections grouped by PostgreSQL state.

targets.rawSql:
select coalesce(state, 'unknown') as metric, count(*)::double precision as value
from pg_stat_activity
where datname = current_database()
group by coalesce(state, 'unknown')
order by value desc;

panels.title: Connections by State

panels.description: Largest Harry indexes with their scan count since statistics reset. Large indexes with no scans are candidates for investigation, not automatic removal.

targets.rawSql:
select schemaname, relname as table_name, indexrelname as index_name,
       idx_scan, pg_relation_size(indexrelid)::bigint as index_bytes
from pg_stat_user_indexes
where relname like 'oracle\_%' escape '\'
   or relname like 'harry_repository_daily_ingest%'
order by index_bytes desc
limit 30;

panels.title: Largest Harry Indexes

panels.description: Previous complete UTC day compared with the preceding seven complete days. DROP and SURGE are operational review signals; workload schedules and weekends can legitimately change ingestion volume.

targets.rawSql:
with daily as (
  select sample_day::date as sample_day, source_database, sql_sample_rows,
         additional_metric_rows + sql_sample_rows + sql_text_writes + sql_plan_operation_writes +
         session_sample_rows + blocking_session_sample_rows + database_activity_sample_rows +
         database_status_sample_rows + instance_sample_rows + resource_limit_sample_rows +
         tablespace_sample_rows + asm_diskgroup_sample_rows + system_counter_sample_rows +
         wait_class_sample_rows + system_metric_sample_rows + scrape_status_rows as total_rows
  from harry_repository_daily_ingest
  where sample_day >= date_trunc('day', now() at time zone 'UTC') - interval '8 days'
    and source_database in (${source_database:sqlstring})
), comparison as (
  select source_database,
         max(total_rows) filter (where sample_day = (now() at time zone 'UTC')::date - 1) as yesterday_rows,
         avg(total_rows) filter (where sample_day between (now() at time zone 'UTC')::date - 8 and (now() at time zone 'UTC')::date - 2) as baseline_rows,
         max(sql_sample_rows) filter (where sample_day = (now() at time zone 'UTC')::date - 1) as yesterday_sql_rows,
         avg(sql_sample_rows) filter (where sample_day between (now() at time zone 'UTC')::date - 8 and (now() at time zone 'UTC')::date - 2) as baseline_sql_rows
  from daily
  group by source_database
)
select source_database, yesterday_rows, round(baseline_rows)::bigint as baseline_rows,
       case when baseline_rows > 0 then (yesterday_rows - baseline_rows) * 100.0 / baseline_rows end as total_change_pct,
       yesterday_sql_rows, round(baseline_sql_rows)::bigint as baseline_sql_rows,
       case when baseline_sql_rows > 0 then (yesterday_sql_rows - baseline_sql_rows) * 100.0 / baseline_sql_rows end as sql_change_pct,
       case when baseline_rows >= 10000 and yesterday_rows > baseline_rows * 3 then 'SURGE'
            when baseline_sql_rows >= 1000 and yesterday_sql_rows < baseline_sql_rows * 0.2 then 'DROP'
            else 'NORMAL' end as review_signal
from comparison
where yesterday_rows is not null
order by review_signal, abs(coalesce((yesterday_rows - baseline_rows) / nullif(baseline_rows, 0), 0)) desc;

panels.title: Ingestion Change vs 7-Day Baseline

panels.description: Thirty times the average physical size of complete daily Harry partitions from the last seven days. This estimates 30 days of newly ingested partition storage before retention removes old partitions.

targets.rawSql:
with daily_sizes as (
  select to_date(substring(child.relname from '([0-9]{4}_[0-9]{2}_[0-9]{2})$'), 'YYYY_MM_DD') as sample_day,
         sum(pg_total_relation_size(child.oid))::numeric as bytes
  from pg_class root
  join pg_namespace n on n.oid = root.relnamespace
  cross join lateral pg_partition_tree(root.oid) t
  join pg_class child on child.oid = t.relid
  where n.nspname = current_schema() and root.relkind = 'p'
    and (root.relname like 'oracle\_%' escape '\' or root.relname = 'harry_repository_daily_ingest')
    and t.isleaf
  group by 1
)
select coalesce(avg(bytes) * 30, 0)::double precision as value
from daily_sizes
where sample_day between (now() at time zone 'UTC')::date - 7 and (now() at time zone 'UTC')::date - 1;

panels.title: Projected 30-Day Ingest Storage

panels.description: Latest persisted collector result for selected Oracle databases. Failed and stale rows remain visible even when no performance samples were produced.

targets.rawSql:
select source_database, collector, success, collected_at as last_collection,
       extract(epoch from now() - collected_at)::double precision as data_age_seconds,
       duration_seconds, sample_count, error_message
from oracle_latest_scrape_status
where source_database in (${source_database:sqlstring})
order by success, data_age_seconds desc, source_database, collector;

panels.title: Harry Collector Freshness and Results

panels.description: Latest sample counts summed across selected source databases. Unexpected zeros or large changes indicate collector, privilege, connection, or workload changes.

targets.rawSql:
select collector as metric, sum(sample_count)::double precision as value
from oracle_latest_scrape_status
where source_database in (${source_database:sqlstring})
group by collector
order by value desc;

panels.title: Latest Samples by Collector

list.definition: select source_database as __text, source_database as __value from oracle_latest_scrape_status where collector = 'scheduled' order by source_database;
list.label: Source Database
list.name: source_database
list.query: select source_database as __text, source_database as __value from oracle_latest_scrape_status where collector = 'scheduled' order by source_database;

title: Harry PostgreSQL Repository Health
